name: FEX-Emu
summary: x86/x86_64 usermode emulator for ARM64 (binaries only)
description: Installs FEX emulator binaries (FEX, FEXBash, FEXRootFSFetcher, …). Prefers apt when available; otherwise builds from source (needs fex-build-deps). Does NOT download x86 RootFS — install fex-rootfs next for full proot use. binfmt skipped under proot.
